jobs.occupation: Coatings Formulation Specialist - DTU Chemical Engineering
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Coatings Formulation Specialist to strengthen CoaST’s capabilities in advanced paint and coating technologies. 

The job
In this role, you will act as a key advisor on formulation strategy and contribute to the development of innovative coating solutions through hands‑on project work and supervision of researchers. Each year, around 30 students and researchers join our group - not only to learn about coatings and paint formulation, but to develop genuine expertise in the field.

Key Responsibilities

• Supervise, mentor, and train students and researchers - from core formulation principles to advanced and technically challenging formulation tasks. You will also be responsible for delivering our internal 5 ECTS Coatings Formulation Course.
• Shape and advance CoaST’s coatings formulation strategy, ensuring our methodologies, models, and tools remain cutting‑edge and aligned with the latest scientific and industrial developments.
• Contribute to research and innovation in next‑generation coating systems together with our researchers, providing expert insight that drives enhanced functionalities and performance improvements.
• Drive selected formulation projects, delivering robust and innovative coating solutions that support the strategic needs of CoaST.
We are looking for a colleague who combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset - someone who can guide and lead others, inspire new ideas, and deliver high‑quality formulation work. The ideal candidate thrives in mentoring and working closely with young researchers, helping them grow their skills and develop confidence within the field.

You will report to the Technical Manager and work closely with a team of skilled supporting technicians.

Our expectations of you

• Proven expertise: Industrial R&D experience in coatings formulation.
• Educational background: BSc or MSc in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field.
• Personal qualities: Highly motivated, structured, and ambitious. You enjoy solving technical challenges and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Communication and personal effectiveness: You communicate clearly and confidently, and you thrive in a dynamic, fast‑paced work environment.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

You are employed as an Academic Officer or Senior Officer. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 February 2027 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus. 

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 1 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Senior Executive Officer, Claus Erik Weinell on cwei@kt.dtu.dk. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

• be acknowledged as a world leading chemical and biochemical engineering department.

• be an attractive as a place to work for ambitious and technology-passionate staff members

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team - Gram Equipment A/S
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?

At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.

Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership

As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.

• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.

• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.

• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.

• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.

• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.

• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.

• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.

• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.

• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.

• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.

• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.

• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.

• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.

• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.

• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.

• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.

Your personality makes the difference

For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.

• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.

• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.

• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.

• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.

• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.

You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.

What you can expect from us

At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.

• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.

• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.

• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.

• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.

• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.

• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.

Ready to take ownership and make a difference?

If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Join Gram Equipment and take the lead in developing our Hardware Team and delivering high-quality, efficient, and competitive automation solutions.

Mechanic/Product Design/Automation/Quality/Project Management, Engineering

Full-time Position

About us

At Gram Equipment, we foster an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where every individual can grow and contribute. Our core values of trust, respect, and dedication guide us in creating a culture of collaboration and excellence.

• People Focus: We prioritize the development and well-being of our team.

• Dedication: We go the extra mile to support our customers and colleagues.

Our mission is clear: to lead the industry with sustainable solutions that benefit both our customers and the planet.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in PHA Processing and Modification by Reactive Extrusion - DTU Chemical Engineering
jobs.description:
If you are excited by doing reactive extrusion, online monitoring and materials characterization for renewable polymer systems such as PHAs, this could be the PhD project for you.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The objective of this PhD project is to develop next-generation polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) compounds through advanced polymer processing, formulation, and reactive extrusion. The project will focus on improving processability and performance while establishing relationships between formulation, processing history, polymer structure, and final material properties. 

As a PhD student, you will prepare and process new PHA formulations using extrusion-based methods, investigate reactive processing and novel additive concepts, and evaluate compounds for injection moulding, extrusion, and blow moulding. You will combine offline polymer characterization with online and in-line analytical methods to monitor changes during processing and support adaptive control of composition and process conditions. 

We are therefore looking for candidates with: 

• Practical experience in polymer processing, preferably extrusion or reactive extrusion, obtained through MSc studies or equivalent research activities. 
• A strong interest in biopolymers (natural polymers), polymer formulation, compounding, and structure-property-processing relationships. 
• Hands-on experience with polymer characterization, particularly FTIR, rheology, DSC, TGA, and NMR. 
• Experience with Raman spectroscopy, online analysis, or process monitoring, which will be considered an advantage. 
• Experience with injection moulding, film or profile extrusion, or blow moulding, which will be considered an advantage. 
• The ability to plan experimental work independently and collaborate effectively across polymer chemistry, processing, and analytical disciplines. 
• An interest in teaching and supervising student projects as part of the PhD programme. 
The project is expected to generate new knowledge on the processing and stabilization of PHA-based materials and to deliver high-performance compounds designed for safe handling, demanding processing routes, and environmentally benign end-of-life scenarios. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

jobs.description:

  Our research
 The Department of Immunology and Microbiology at University of Copenhagen is a unique interdisciplinary research flagship exploring the biology of pathogenic microbes and our immune system, with the aim of improving population health.

  Your job
 The Staff Scientist will work on a project concerning the development of chemical compounds that inhibit production of toxins in Staphylococcus aureus and impede the pathogenic effects of the bacterium in atopic dermatitis. This entails:

   	
• Plan, prioritize and carry out the project in accordance with its scientific objectives, milestones, budget and reporting requirements. 	
• Coordinate project activities with laboratory technical staff and internal and external collaborators and supervise students or junior researchers where relevant. 	
• Maintain research documentation and data-management practices and ensure compliance with laboratory safety, research-integrity and relevant institutional requirements. 	
• Prepare scientific publications, conference presentations, seminars, workshops, reports and relevant outreach activities. 	
• Develop follow-up research directions, collaborations and applications for further competitive research funding.   Because the work is research-driven, its detailed timing and sequence cannot be fully predetermined. Within the agreed scientific and institutional framework, the Staff Scientist will independently determine day-to-day priorities, experimental design and methods, the sequence of experiments and analyses, and the coordination of collaborations.

• Experience with preparing scientific reports, manuscripts and presentations. Previous scientific publications are considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Black Hole Astrophysics
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and accomplished Postdoc scientist to work at the intersection of theory, simulation, and data analysis in black hole astrophysics for a four-year position, commencing on 1 March 2027.

  Information about the Department can be found at: The Niels Bohr International Academy – University of Copenhagen

  Your job

  The Assistant Professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Assistant professorship. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties

  Specifically, the chosen applicant is required to work on the following problems

  1) Are extragalactic jets seen throughout the Universe really powered by black hole spin energy and can we prove it with polarimetric observations?

  2) How do gravity, radiation, and high-energy particles interact to determine the structure and dynamics of accretion disks and the jet launching region around low luminosity AGN?

  3) What is the best way to use sparse and noisy observations from Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) arrays to precisely measure the properties of black holes and their astrophysical environments?

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies:

  Essential experience and skills:

  In order to pursue these questions, the chosen candidate must have a substantial record of leadership in the global Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration as well as a role in the project team for the proposed NASA Black Hole Explorer (BHEX) mission.

  The chosen candidate must have a proven track record in the analysis of VLBI data, running and interpreting General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations, and building semi-analytic models of black hole accretion and jet launching for comparison with extremely high-resolution EHT data. jobs.occupation: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt i hele organisationen. Både internt med økonomikonsulenter og økonomipartnere om forskellige ad hoc analyser og beregninger, men også bredt på tværs af fagområderne. I den forbindelse vil du også komme til at arbejde med udvikling af økonomistyring, økonomiske modeller og metoder, der understøtter VIA’s kerneopgave. 

Formidlingsstærk og analytisk profil med stærke relationelle kompetencer

Vi søger en initiativrig, selvstændig, analytisk og nysgerrig kollega, som har lyst til at gøre en forskel. Du har en oprigtig samfundsinteresse koblet med en stor nysgerrighed som tilgang til dit arbejde. Du har fortrolighed med at fremskaffe data, glædes ved at analysere dem og se sammenhængene, og du begejstres ved at beskrive og præsentere dem.  Samtidig har du blik for modtagerens behov, og ser det som en central del af din rolle at skabe et relevant og solidt beslutningsgrundlag for budgetansvarlige chefer og direktører.

Du har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse på kandidatniveau f.eks. cand.oecon., cand.merc. el.lign. Det er en fordel hvis du har erfaring gerne fra uddannelsesområdet eller offentlig sektor i øvrigt, men du kan også komme i betragtning som nyuddannet. Det vigtigste er, at du formår at skabe overblik og arbejde med - og begejstres over - komplekse problemstillinger.

Om stillingen

Stillingen er forankret i Budget og Analyse, som er en del af VIA Økonomi. Budget og Analyse understøtter de budgetansvarlige på alle niveauer i VIA ift. økonomistyring. Der er to funktioner/teams på kontoret: Økonomipartnerne, som har dialogerne med de mange budgetansvarlige og analysefunktionen, som varetager de mere konsoliderende funktioner og tværgående analyser. Der arbejdes meget på tværs mellem de to funktioner og målsætningen er, at dette samarbejde skal forstærkes yderligere i kommende periode. Denne nye stilling skal indgå i denne målsætning. I første omgang vil placeringen være i analysefunktionen, men der vil være konkrete opgaver, der skal varetages sammen med økonomipartnerne.

Du vil være i direkte reference til budgetchefen og have både økonomikonsulenter og økonomipartnere som nærmeste kollegaer. VIA Økonomi består desuden af 2 yderligere kontorer: Regnskab og Projektøkonomi samt Finans og Indkøb. Vi er i alt ca. 50 medarbejdere i Økonomi. 

I VIA Økonomi har vi ambitioner om at bidrage til VIA’s kerneopgave ved at fortsat at være en relevant og troværdig samarbejdspartner for resten af VIA’s organisation. Ambitionerne udfoldes både i et fokus på løbende kompetenceudvikling af medarbejdere, i anvendelse af ny teknologi, kunstig intelligens og tidssvarende processer.

Ansættelsesvilkår 
Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Dit primære arbejdssted bliver Campus Aarhus N, Hedeager 2, 8200 Aarhus N. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage under hensyntagen til løsning af arbejdsopgaverne.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende aftaler og overenskomster. Stillingen forventes besat efter overenskomsten for akademikere i staten med indplacering som AC-fuldmægtig.

Vi håber, at du kan starte den 1. marts 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter. 

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. december 2026.  

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 51 og evt. 2. runde i den første uge af januar.

Vil du vide mere? 

Kontakt chef for Budget og Analyse: Søren Jermiin Olesen på 8755 1147 eller Specialkonsulent Eva Bagge Bodorf på 8755 1149 for en uforpligtende snak.

VI er VIA  
VIA er en af Danmarks største uddannelsesinstitutioner med lokationer overalt i Region Midtjylland. Vi uddanner og efteruddanner bl.a. lærere, sygeplejersker, ingeniører, designere og mange flere. Vi udvikler uddannelser i tæt samarbejde med praksis. Vi er en arbejdsplads med fleksibilitet, frihed og gode muligheder for udvikling. Hvis du er nysgerrig på, hvordan det er at arbejde i VIA, kan du læse nogle af vores fortællinger her.   

I VIA værdsætter vi kompetence og talent i alle former. Vi tror på styrken i diversitet og byder alle velkomne, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet eller baggrund. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen og blive en del af et inkluderende fællesskab.

jobs.occupation: Senior Engineering Specialist – Drug Substance Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**Shape the engineering solutions behind vaccines that protect lives every day

**Are you an experienced bioprocess engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to set direction and bring people together?

Join Bavarian Nordic and take a leading role in shaping the processes and systems that support our Drug Substance manufacturing.

From major capital projects and technology transfers to solving complex manufacturing challenges, you will help ensure our processes are robust, scalable, and ready for reliable operation.

**Your impact

**As Senior Engineering Specialist, you will serve as a technical authority for integrated bioprocess systems across process engineering, automation, filtration, and equipment design.

You will guide critical technical decisions throughout the manufacturing lifecycle—from concept and scale-up through qualification, validation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad technical responsibility and influence across functions and projects. You will lead technical workstreams and mentor experienced engineers without formal line-management responsibility.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, Quality, Validation, and external partners, you will:

• Lead bioprocess design and optimization: Set the technical direction for upstream and downstream processes, purification, bulk formulation, and sterile transfers. Use process knowledge, modelling, and manufacturing data to improve yield, capacity, reliability, and product quality.

• Shape automation and control strategies: Translate process needs into requirements for PLC/DCS and SCADA systems, recipes, sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Ensure solutions support effective process control, data integrity, and reliable operation.

• Provide technical leadership for filtration: Define filter selection, sizing, validation, and integrity-testing strategies for liquid and gas systems. Lead investigations into filter failures, pressure deviations, and performance issues.

• Guide equipment and system design: Review and approve tanks, piping, pumps, valves, and instrumentation, including hydraulic calculations, pressure distribution, and pressure-testing strategies. Lead technical decisions for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place (CIP/SIP) systems.

• Deliver projects and technology transfers: Lead process engineering activities from concept and vendor selection through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, process validation, and handover to operations.

• Strengthen technical standards and compliance: Resolve complex investigations, support change controls and CAPAs, and represent engineering during audits and inspections. Establish reusable design standards and share knowledge across projects and teams.

**What You Bring

**You have a master’s degree or PhD in Bioengineering, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

You bring substantial industrial experience, typically 15 years or more, including at least 10 years within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or vaccine manufacturing.

Your experience includes:

• Leading complex engineering projects as a lead engineer or technical authority, with hands-on expertise in bioprocess development, scale-up, commercial manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Integrating process equipment with automation and SCADA systems, including control strategies, computerized-system validation, and data integrity.

• Designing and validating filtration systems, including filter integrity testing and pressure/flow troubleshooting.

• Working with hygienic tanks and piping, hydraulic calculations, pressure testing, CIP/SIP, and contamination control.

• Leading commissioning, qualification, process validation, Process Performance Qualification, and technology transfer, supported by a strong understanding of GMP and quality risk management.

• Setting technical standards, mentoring experienced engineers, and influencing decisions across functions without relying on formal authority.

**How You Work

**You combine scientific depth with practical engineering judgement. You can move from detailed technical analysis to clear recommendations that help colleagues and leaders make informed decisions.

You take ownership, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain focused when problems span multiple systems or disciplines. Whether working with operators, specialists, suppliers, or senior stakeholders, you communicate clearly and build trust through sound decisions and consistent follow-through.

You also enjoy developing others. Sharing expertise, coaching colleagues, and creating common standards are natural parts of how you work.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. In this role, you will help build and improve the manufacturing capabilities that make that purpose possible.

You will have the opportunity to influence major technical decisions, strengthen engineering practices, and see your work translate into measurable improvements in manufacturing performance and reliable supply.

Our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—shape how we collaborate and solve challenges. For the right candidate, sustained performance may open opportunities for broader engineering leadership or formal people management.

**Ready to shape the future of our Drug Substance manufacturing?

**We look forward to receiving your application and learning how your technical expertise and leadership could strengthen Bavarian Nordic.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com
